paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: faith in Jesus is where everything in this letter starts. The writer says everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God (1 John 5:1). And the very next thing he says is that everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him. So if you believe, you didn't just sign up for a belief, you got born into a FAMILY!

Now, that family has a way of showing love. The writer says we know we love the children of God when we love God and keep His commandments (1 John 5:2). Then he says His commandments are not burdensome, because everyone born of God overcomes the world (1 John 5:3-4). I think that's the part to hold onto when the day feels heavy, because the victory that has overcome the world is our faith (1 John 5:4). Not our muscles, not our résumé, just faith in Jesus the Son of God (1 John 5:5).

And here's why you can stand on it. The writer says the testimony of God is greater than human testimony (1 John 5:9), and that testimony is this: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son (1 John 5:11). Whoever has the Son has life (1 John 5:12). No fine print, no asterisk, just a gift, so go bake with a full heart today!
